# @aponiajs/mvc

> Multi-engine bridges for Next.js, Nuxt, Angular, Express, and Fastify.

## Exports

- `createNextHandler(nextApp)`: Next.js request bridge
- `createNuxtHandler(nuxtApp)`: Nuxt 3 / Nitro request bridge
- `createAngularHandler(commonEngine, options?)`: Angular SSR bridge
- `toExpressHandler(application)`: Express middleware adapter
- `toFastifyHandler(application)`: Fastify plugin adapter
